description: Dedicated HGRApi tool for POST api/VirtualAssistants/Invite. This is an explicit tool with a fixed endpoint; it is not a generic endpoint caller. HGRApi functional documentation: Purpose: Sends a single-use, seven-day email invitation; a changed email or reinvitation withdraws previous access until acceptance. ownerAgent: account-metrics. Use when: Invite a new VA, enable a historical profile, change the verified recipient or resend an invitation. Input: Optional profile Id, Name, Email, Stores with exact owned ChannelOAuthId and permission codes, Language. Resending requires the exact existing Id; omitting Id never reuses an existing profile. Output: Saves the relationship and sends the email; never sets or returns a password. Returns 400 with va_owner_email for the owner's email or va_email_already_used for an email assigned to another VA, ignoring case and surrounding whitespace. Maximum 3 active or invited VAs per account; acquiring another slot returns 409 va_profile_limit. Existing access is not automatically revoked. Maximum 3 distinct recipient emails per rolling 24 hours, including removed, suspended or revoked profiles and previous addresses of edited profiles. After the initial invitation, only 1 resend per recipient per rolling 24 hours. Email limits return 429 va_distinct_email_limit or va_invitation_resend_limit with Retry-After and retryAfterSeconds. Saved attempts count even when delivery fails. Limit rejections preserve the profile, permissions and existing invitations and send no email. Search terms: virtualassistants invite. Send the exact request payload in body. Requires confirmed=true before execution.

confirmed.description: Must be true after the user explicitly requested or confirmed the exact action.
